side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across the source three-encoding roster on 32 fresh equally weighted complete pairs, exactly 16 one-or-more and 16 exactly-one, versus careful English carrying both cardinality bounds.
admissibility_gates: all 32 pairs are present and unique
each English control explicitly states the relevant lower and upper cardinality bounds
no complete English or Ainglish sentence duplicates the 32-pair source manifest
all three registered encodings load and match the preregistered deterministic fingerprints
every finite result is filed once regardless of sign or agreement

manifest.test_set_note: fresh registered marker versus shortest careful English carrying both the lower and upper cardinality bounds; exactly 16 cells per form with equal weight

estimand.population: all 32 frozen complete minimal pairs, exactly 16 per form
estimand.aggregation: mean per tokenizer over the form-balanced population; headline is the least-favourable maximum mean

manifest.evidentiary_limit: price prerequisite only; token count is not comprehension evidence

source.input_relation: all 64 complete English/Ainglish sentence surfaces are new relative to the source manifest

manifest.method: Freeze all 32 complete pairs before importing tiktoken. Then use ordinary encoding with no special tokens. For each encoding, report the mean over all 32 equally weighted cells and separate 16-cell form means. File the least-favourable maximum encoding mean, the full vector, and all per-pair deltas regardless of outcome. No comprehension or adoption inference is permitted.
